code:
df.memory_usage(deep=False).sum()
# understates object columns

df.memory_usage(deep=True).sum()
# the real number -- walks every
# string's actual contents
caption: Always use deep=True before deciding a DataFrame is "too big".
Reduce each chunk, merge partial results -- never hold the whole file.

code:
pd.to_numeric(df.qty,
              downcast="integer")
# int64 -> int16, if it fits
pd.to_numeric(df.price,
              downcast="float")
# float64 -> float32
caption: Smallest dtype that still holds every value, losslessly for ints.

code:
df["ticker"] = df["ticker"]\
    .astype("category")
# stores each unique value once
# + an int code per row
# typically 90%+ smaller
caption: The highest-leverage fix for repeated-string columns like tickers.
